history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with a dark, slicked-back hairstyle and black sunglasses is sitting in the driver's seat of a dark-colored car. He is holding a silver smartphone to his left ear with his right hand, engaged in a phone conversation. He is wearing a black t-shirt and a chunky silver bracelet on his right wrist. The interior of the car shows a beige leather seat and headrest. The car's exterior is dark, with a chrome door handle visible on the left side. The side mirror, on the right side of the car, has a carbon fiber texture with integrated turn signals. The background is slightly blurred, showing a hazy sky with soft clouds and the silhouettes of trees and foliage, suggesting an outdoor setting, possibly during the day with diffused light. The overall mood is casual and relaxed. The color palette is dominated by dark grays and blacks of the car, contrasted with the lighter beige interior and the muted tones of the background sky and greenery. The lighting is soft and even, with no harsh shadows. The photograph is taken from a slightly low angle, focusing on the man and the car.
